name: Hill Titan
description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Gullible
abilities.description: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

abilities.name: Bug Swarm
abilities.description: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

abilities.name: Mighty Swing
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.
